# Decisions

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

`game.pending_decision` returns the decision below; submit one of its `options`.

## assign_damage

Assign one point of combat damage of `attacker`: `{type: "assign", object: blocker_id}`. `remaining` points are left.

## bottom

Right after a mulligan, put one card from the new hand on the bottom of the library: `{type: "bottom", object: id}`, once per mulligan taken so far, before declaring again. Hidden from the opponent (CR 103.5).

## choose_cost

While casting/activating: `{type: "cost", object: id}` picks the permanent (or card) a cost uses (the creature to tap for station, the creature to sacrifice, the creature beamed up, ...); `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds. `cost` describes the cost.

## choose_kicker

While casting a spell with kicker: `{type: "kick"}` pays the kicker cost too, `{type: "no_kick"}` doesn't; `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds. `cost` describes the kicker cost.

## choose_mode

Choose a mode of a modal ("choose one") spell or ability: `{type: "mode", mode: index}` (0-based, in printed order); `{type: "done"}` once enough are chosen when more are allowed; `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds a cast. `choose` modes in total (at least `min`).

## choose_target

While casting/activating: `{type: "target", target: ref}` for the next target (ref is an object id or "player:<name>"); `{type: "done"}` chooses no more for an "up to" target; `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds the whole cast.

## choose_x

While casting/activating a spell or ability with {X} in its cost: `{type: "x", value: n}` announces X (0 up to `max`, the most the available mana could pay for); `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds.

## declare_attackers

Declare one attacker: `{type: "attack", object: id, target: ref}` (the defending player or one of their planeswalkers), or `{type: "done"}` (withheld while a creature that attacks each combat if able could still attack, CR 508.1d, or while a creature that can't attack alone attacks alone, CR 506.5; then `{type: "withdraw", object: id}` undoes an attack).

## declare_blockers

Declare one blocker: `{type: "block", object: id, attacker: id}`, `{type: "done"}` (only when the blocks are legal), or `{type: "unblock", object: id}` to fix an illegal menace block.

## discard

Cleanup step: discard one card, `{type: "discard", object: id}`, until the hand has 7 cards. `count` is how many remain (CR 514.1).

## distribute

While casting: `{type: "assign", target: ref}` gives one more of the divided amount to that target (each target already has one); `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds. `left` is what remains to divide.

## effect_choice

A choice made while an effect resolves (scry, surveil, discard...): submit one of the `choices` exactly as listed; `prompt` describes it.

## enter_choice

Before `object` enters: `{type: "pay_life", life: n}` (only with enough life) or `{type: "enter_tapped"}` (CR 614.12, 119.4); `{type: "number", number: n}` for "choose a number"; `{type: "name", name: "..."}` for "choose a card name" (CR 201.4).

## legend_rule

Keep one of your legendary permanents named `name`: `{type: "keep", object: id}`; the others go to the graveyard (CR 704.5j).

## mulligan

Keep the hand (`{type: "keep"}`) or take a London mulligan (`{type: "mulligan"}`). Players declare in turn order; mulligans then happen simultaneously (CR 103.5).

## order_triggers

Put one of your pending triggered abilities on the stack next: `{type: "trigger", trigger: id}` (CR 603.3b). The last one put on the stack resolves first.

## pay_cost

While casting/activating or paying a cost: `{type: "pay_mana", mana: "R"}` spends one mana from the pool (`restricted: i`: restricted mana, CR 106.6), `{type: "activate_mana", object: id, ability: ref}` (plus `mana: "{G}{G}"` when the mana is chosen) taps a source, `{type: "cancel"}` rewinds (or declines a payment asked for while resolving). Cancel isn't offered once a mana ability with a cost other than {T} (a Treasure) has been activated. `remaining` shows what is left to pay.

## play_or_draw

The die-roll winner chooses `{type: "play"}` or `{type: "draw"}` (CR 103.1).

## priority

The player holding priority takes an action or passes. Options come from the priority actions below (CR 117).

## untap_choice

Untap step: `{type: "untap", object: id}` or `{type: "keep_tapped", object: id}` for a permanent you may choose not to untap (CR 502.3).

## Priority actions

- `activate` — `{type: "activate", object: id, ability: ref}` — start activating an ability (CR 602.2), including planeswalker loyalty abilities (CR 606) and abilities of cards in your hand (cycling, CR 702.29).
- `activate_mana` — `{type: "activate_mana", object: id, ability: ref}` — activate a mana ability; it resolves immediately (CR 605.3). `mana: "{G}{G}"` names the mana when it is chosen as the ability is activated.
- `cast` — `{type: "cast", object: id}` — start casting a card from your hand (CR 601.2). `{type: "cast", object: id, via: method}` casts a card from another zone (graveyard, exile, the top of your library) by the permission or alternative cost `via` names, e.g. beam me up (CR 601.3, 702.196). A card outside the game is named `"outside:<card id>"` (CR 400.11b). Offered only when timing allows, targets exist and enough mana is available.
- `pass` — `{type: "pass"}` — pass priority. When all players pass in succession with an empty stack, the step ends (CR 117.4).
- `play_land` — `{type: "play_land", object: id}` — special action: your main phase, empty stack, one land per turn plus additional land plays (CR 305.1, 305.2). With `via`: a land from another zone that an effect lets you play.
